question: Which import goods had the largest declines in value between 2019 and 2020 during the COVID-19 crisis in Luxembourg?

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
3.5 % of this value is confidential at full product detail (masked codes); it is shown as a separate 'Confidential' slice, never dropped.

sql:
SELECT
  year,
  hs2 AS key,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg
FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2021-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND year IN (2019, 2020)
GROUP BY
  year,
  key,
  flow
ORDER BY
  year,
  value_eur DESC
LIMIT 10000
title: Largest changes by product group — imports 2019–2020

insight: The import goods with the largest declines in value between 2019 and 2020 in Luxembourg were Electrical machinery and equipment, which fell by 1.38 billion euros, and Mineral fuels and oils, which decreased by 757.6 million euros.
The total value of imports for Electrical machinery and equipment dropped from 2.58 billion euros in 2019 to 1.20 billion euros in 2020.
This decline was more significant than the 37.2% decrease seen in Mineral fuels and oils imports.
These changes occurred during the COVID-19 crisis in 2020.
The data are in current euros and do not account for price changes, and 3.5% of the import values are confidential and not detailed.
